title: Temple of Lost Revenue
description: Procedural multi-floor 3D maze crawler. Collect 5 gold Leads per floor to unlock the Exit Portal while dodging Audit Golems and stunning them with Decipher Pulse.

maker.name: Madi AI Creative Team
maker.bio: Building the future of autonomous revenue engines.

instructions: Use WASD or Arrows to navigate procedural 3D maze floors. Collect 5 gold Leads to unlock the green Exit Portal, and press Space, Shift, or E to fire Decipher Pulse and stun pursuing Audit Golems.
